lede: The big one this week is Thursday's Planning and Zoning Commission meeting, where three Town-owned development projects in the Accommodations 2 zone — including the Carhenge Redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — are up for preliminary subdivision and concept review. Also on Thursday, SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts tied to the gondola structural analysis, which is about as close to a bridge-or-bust decision as this valley gets. A Special Town Council session Sunday takes up a public hearing on KOTO Radio's Live at the Drive liquor permit for July 30.
